decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the firm's strategy of trusted, binding mobile communication, so it is likely kept or folded into the broader platform even though it was not visible on the website in 2020–2021.
Mobile PDF signing fits the stated push toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain, but its absence from the website suggests it may be merged into a larger offering.
Hardware signature tokens are losing ground to app-based authentication in the firm's mobile-first ecosystem, and the product's disappearance from the website points to withdrawal.

A standalone payment-network compliance suite lies outside the firm's move toward one secure identity across channels, and it was no longer visible on the website, so its resources are better used in the core platform.
